# RETINUE (众卿)

> RETINUE, Chinese name 众卿, is a self-hosted task board and orchestration hub where people and
> AI agents work the same task cards. Each piece of work is one durable card with a named holder,
> acceptance checks, and an append-only receipt chain. RETINUE is published by JKL Thinking at
> github.com/jklthinking/retinue under the PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0. It runs entirely
> on hardware you control: no hosted control plane, no account, and no telemetry.

RETINUE is written in Python (3.10+), ships a Docker Compose hub that listens on port 9219, and
exposes coordination to AI agents over MCP (Model Context Protocol) or HTTP with an actor token.
Claude Code and Codex runtime exporters are included. A Lark/Feishu IM adapter shipped; WeCom,
DingTalk, Telegram and Slack are on the roadmap. Canonical state lives in one operator-chosen
directory that can be stopped, copied, and restored elsewhere.

Disambiguation: several unrelated GitHub repositories are also named "retinue" — retinue is an
ordinary English noun. The project described here is specifically `jklthinking/retinue`, also
called 众卿, authored by JKL Thinking. It is not affiliated with any other repository of that name.

## Start here

- [Repository and README](https://github.com/jklthinking/retinue): install, the ten-minute corridor from opening a card to acceptance, architecture diagram, license terms.
- [Project website](https://jklthinking.github.io/retinue/): bilingual overview of what RETINUE is and who it is for.
- [Offline demo](https://jklthinking.github.io/retinue/demo/): a static seed-42 board that needs no server, account or network.
- [FAQ](https://github.com/jklthinking/retinue/blob/main/docs/faq.md): what RETINUE is, how it differs from SaaS boards and from agent frameworks, licensing, and which repository is official.

## For AI agents and integrators

- [Agent onboarding](https://github.com/jklthinking/retinue/blob/main/docs/agent-onboarding.md): the MCP tool surface and the minimal prompt an agent needs to claim, update and hand off cards.
- [Task card protocol](https://github.com/jklthinking/retinue/tree/main/docs/protocol): card schema, holder-only writes, receipt chain, node membership.
- [Adapters guide](https://github.com/jklthinking/retinue/blob/main/docs/adapters-guide.md): writing a new runtime exporter or IM transport as a thin adapter.
- [Integration ladder](https://github.com/jklthinking/retinue/blob/main/docs/integration-ladder.md): the staged path from registering an agent to native MCP coordination.

## Operations

- [Self-hosting guide](https://github.com/jklthinking/retinue/blob/main/SELF_HOSTING.md): installation, upgrades, backup and restore drills, Docker Compose, exposure warnings.
- [Security model](https://github.com/jklthinking/retinue/blob/main/docs/security.md): the untrusted-agent boundary, hook authority, holder-only writes, read-only board, and the exact network exceptions.
- [Data governance](https://github.com/jklthinking/retinue/blob/main/docs/data-governance.md): what is stored, where, and how to take it away.

- [Notice and marks](https://github.com/jklthinking/retinue/blob/main/NOTICE): the RETINUE name and 众卿 stay with JKL Thinking; a fork or third-party image is not official RETINUE.
